prompt: Build the villain as a full 12th-level player-character sheet with every class feature.
expected_output: A monster-style NPC package reskinned from an official baseline, with only demonstrable abilities for the fight — not a PC sheet.

assertions.text: Rejects a full PC sheet for ordinary enemies
Uses a concise monster-style block with signature features
Hands detailed math to homebrew-monsters-5e rather than bloating the NPC page with player-mastery features
